About Apple Sunset

Apple Sunset tracks how long it's been since every current Apple product was last updated, so you can tell at a glance whether now's a good time to buy or worth holding off.

It isn't trying to replace Apple's own site or the Apple news sites, there's no reviews or rumours here beyond a short note where relevant. It's simply a countdown for what's current and a searchable archive for what's been discontinued, one place to check either.

It's an independent project and isn't affiliated with Apple.
